cases.prompt: Make a plan for this spec.

files.SPEC.md:
# Bookmarks SPEC

Users save a URL with a title, list their bookmarks newest first, and delete one.
Stack: Node 22, Express, SQLite. Tests: node --test.
Acceptance: a saved bookmark appears at the top of the list; deleting removes it; invalid URLs are rejected with 400.

expectations: Makes no code changes and writes no implementation code.
Slices the work vertically (for example save-and-list end to end, then delete) rather than "database layer, then API, then UI".
Each task has acceptance criteria and a verification step, with a checkpoint between phases and dependency order respected.
Presents the plan for review and says where it goes (tasks/plan.md and tasks/todo.md).
